profile.description: China Coal Energy Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of coal in China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Coal, Coal Chemical, Coal Mining Equipment, and Finance. It offers thermal and coking coal products; polyolefin, methanol, urea, and ammonium nitrate; and coal mining machinery and equipment. The company also engages in financial activities; thermal power generation; aluminum processing; import of equipment and related parts; bidding services; iron ore business; road transportation; and waste disposal. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. China Coal Energy Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of China National Coal Group Corporation.

finsights.brief: Holds more cash than debt on its balance sheet
Trading at a high P/E ratio relative to near-term earnings growth

summary: China Coal Energy reported H1 2026 net profit up 5.8% YoY to RMB 8.14B, but EPS of $0.32 missed forecast of $0.385 by 16.9%.
Coal production fell 8% YoY to 61.95M tons due to safety inspections, offset by 11.5% higher average selling prices at RMB 524/ton.
Board approved interim dividend of RMB 0.184/share (4.9% yield) payable before October 2026; operating cash flow surged 28.6% to RMB 9.86B.
Management expects H2 production recovery and cost stabilization; Phase 2 Yulin polyolefin project to start production December 2026.
Stock rose 3.04% to $11.53 post-results as investors focused on pricing power and cash generation despite ongoing safety inspection headwinds.
